interpretation: These are actual existing waits, not the proposed <=30s migration target. A canceled overlapped IO is drained before resources die; drain itself does not have a separate finite timer. No global queue bound exists in the native detached-thread server. Soak samples resource bounds on the stated cached-request workload only.
